name: Gemfibrozil

fda.text: 1. Because of chemical, pharmacological, and clinical similarities between gemfibrozil and clofibrate, the adverse findings with clofibrate in two large clinical studies may also apply to gemfibrozil. examples.title: Exploration of Gemfibrozil as a Treatment for AUD

summary: A warning states that harmful findings from studies on another drug named clofibrate may also relate to gemfibrozil due to similarities in their chemical makeup and how they work. [3] In one of those studies, the subjects examined had previously experienced a myocardial infarction, which is a heart attack. [3] Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated low risk scores of 34 for the liver and 32 for the heart. [M]
